name: resource-inspector
title: Resource Inspector
description: Inspect memory, CPU, disk activity, and Git worktrees. Deliberately close one app, process, or container, or remove one selected worktree.
author: juhas96

commands.name: worktrees
commands.title: Manage Git Worktrees
commands.description: Find worktrees across providers, review branches and creation dates, and remove one selected checkout

commands.name: inspect
commands.title: Inspect Resources
commands.description: Inspect apps, processes, and containers before choosing one to close

commands.name: history
commands.title: Usage History
commands.description: Review locally recorded memory, CPU, and disk activity

commands.name: diagnostics
commands.title: Recent Diagnostics
commands.description: Read recent macOS resource reports, separate from recorded history

commands.name: record
commands.title: Record Resource Usage
commands.description: Record a lightweight local snapshot approximately once a minute

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Resource Inspector Settings
commands.description: Pause recording, clear history, and check monitoring status

scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist --exit-on-error
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && prettier --check src tests native package.json tsconfig.json
